messages:
sec-bot: ALERT: SSO velocity anomaly detected for multiple accounts (rapid logins from US, RU, BR). User: svc-data-ingest + 4 human users. Failed MFA attempts spike. Event at 2026-01-12T14:18:18Z. Auto-throttle triggered.

maria: saw it. @ashwin @joel can you triage? Might be credential stuffing.

ashwin: I'm pulling audit logs now — running query.

ashwin: ```sql
SELECT user, ip, country, event, timestamp
FROM audit.logins
WHERE timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTES)
  AND (country <> 'US' OR failed_mfa_count > 3)
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

joel: results show svc-data-ingest token used from RU and US within 2m, same user-agent 'curl/7.80'. Human users show impossible-travel: IPs in DE then CA within 10m.

samira: multiple human accounts hit lockout after repeated MFA push attempts (MFA fatigue). 5 users locked.

maria: containment: revoke sessions for svc-data-ingest and affected humans. Also disable any tokens created in last 24h.

ashwin: done — revoked active sessions and disabled 3 tokens for svc-data-ingest. command: `adminctl sessions revoke --user svc-data-ingest --force`.

joel: I've applied temporary RBAC restriction: removed 'admin:org' from 2 affected human accounts and enforced step-up via `role:admin -> require-mfa` until review.

samira: created INC-2026-214 in PagerDuty, assigned to sec-oncall. https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-214

maria: Do we need to rotate KMS keys? Rotating primary KMS key will break services. Recommend: revoke compromised service tokens and perform key policy review. @crypto-team FYI.

ashwin: Agreed. Also increased audit retention for SSO logs to 180d for this investigation.

joel: Will run forensic export: `export_logs --ids 1763421098-1763421460 --dest gs://sec-exports/INC-2026-214`.

samira: Notifying legal and compliance. No customer data accessed as far as we can tell.

maria: Communications: internal only for now. We'll draft a brief for all engineers: steps to rotate tokens, check service accounts.

ashwin: Post-incident actions: add velocity rule to SIEM, tune threshold to reduce MFA fatigue false positives, and add dashboard for MFA push anomalies.

joel: Assigning follow-ups in GH: #sec-214 with tasks: audit-logs-pipeline, velocity-rule, token-issuance-hardening, KMS-policy-review.

maria: Thanks team. Keep updates here. :eyes: 

oncall-bot: sec-oncall acknowledged INC-2026-214 — investigating.
